blocks.title: Create
blocks.text: Three vertices (A, B and C) produce a 3 by 3 matrix: one row and one column per vertex. The four-vertex 4×4 example comes later in You Do.

blocks.title: Add undirected edge
blocks.text: The matrix is symmetrical for an undirected connection.

blocks.title: Remove and inspect
blocks.text: Clearing removes an edge; scanning a row finds neighbours.
